map.按客数、客单价与单客耗材测算毛利、净利与盈亏平衡客数: Estimate gross profit, net profit and the break-even customer count from customer volume, average ticket and per-client consumables
map.美业门店的成本分两类：耗材（产品、一次性用品）随客数线性增长，属变动成本；人工、: A salon's costs fall into two groups: consumables (products, single-use items) grow linearly with customer volume and are variable costs; labor, rent and equipment depreciation occur at a fixed monthly amount and are fixed costs. Revenue comes from customer volume times average ticket; subtract variable consumables to get gross profit. Then use "contribution margin per client = average ticket − per-client consumables" to spread fixed costs across every client, which gives the break-even customer count. The business only turns a profit above that number, and the excess is the safety margin. All calculations run locally in your browser and no data is uploaded.

map.单客边际贡献有什么用？: What is the contribution margin per client used for?
map.它是每多服务一位顾客带来的可覆盖固定成本的金额，除以固定成本即得盈亏平衡客数，是: It is the amount each additional customer contributes toward covering fixed costs. Dividing the fixed costs by it gives the break-even customer count, which anchors both customer-acquisition targets and pricing.
